personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium, Apple-quality cinematic FX tool built with deep glassmorphism, floating surfaces, and sleek cinematic gradients.

spacing.rule: Use generous iOS-native margins (16pt/24pt) around the screen edge. Inner component padding should be comfortable, not cramped. Floating action buttons must have safe-area clearance at the bottom.

do's: Use heavy glass (`expo-blur`) for the floating bottom tab bar, sticky headers, and floating primary CTAs.
Apply frosted glass over featured FX cards with image backgrounds to ensure text readability.
Use glassmorphism heavily in the Subscription view for premium pricing cards.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (70%+ opacity) for guaranteed readability.
dont's: Don't use glass on standard form inputs.
Don't forget the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern behind text that sits directly on imagery.
Don't stack more than 2 glass surfaces on top of each other.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the cinematic photo transformation features across 4 full-bleed visual steps.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery underneath a gradient scrim. Title and subtitle positioned in the bottom 40% of the screen. A large, floating glass 'Next' button sits above the safe-area margin. Animated transitions between steps.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: User registration and login (Email, Apple, Google).

states.error: Standard alert or inline red text below the offending input.

screens.layout: Clean iOS form layout. Big Apple/Google SSO buttons stacked vertically, followed by email entry. Top-left back button.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main launchpad for uploading/capturing photos and accessing top FX.

states.empty: Empty state illustration in the Recent Projects section.
states.error: Retry block for fetching popular effects.

screens.layout: Header with user avatar and Settings cog. Two large side-by-side 'Camera' and 'Upload' primary action cards. Below that, a horizontal scrolling carousel of 'Popular Effects'. A 'Premium Banner' utilizing glassmorphism and the brand gradient. A grid/list of 'Recent Projects' at the bottom. Floating bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Effects Grid
screens.purpose: Browse the full catalog of cinematic effects.

states.empty: No effects found for this category.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with horizontal pill-shaped category filters (Face, Vehicle, House, Object). A 2-column masonry or symmetrical grid of effects underneath. Each card shows a thumbnail and effect name. Cards use smooth scaling on press.

screens.name: Effect Selection Detail
screens.purpose: Preview a specific effect and apply it to a new photo.
screens.layout: Large hero header featuring an automated before/after looping animation or static split image. Content underneath details the effect. A sticky floating 'Apply Effect' gradient CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Camera/Upload
screens.layout: Full-screen camera viewfinder with Apple-native aesthetic. Circular shutter button, gallery picker icon, and camera swap icon.

screens.name: Processing

states.loading: Lottie animation (e.g., scanning line over the image).

screens.layout: Dark, immersive screen. Central image with a glowing scanning effect and a 'Applying Cinematic Magic...' progress text.

screens.name: Result
screens.purpose: Show the transformed image with an interactive before/after slider.
screens.layout: Full-screen or large centered canvas containing the before/after slider (PanGestureHandler). Bottom row contains actions: 'Save to Gallery', 'Share' (triggers native share sheet or bottom sheet with Instagram/TikTok icons), and 'Done'.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: View, search, favorite, and delete past generations.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty film reel ('No cinematic shots yet').

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top. Two tabs: 'All' and 'Favorites'. 2-column grid of generated images. Long-press on an image triggers a context menu to delete or share.

screens.name: Subscription (Premium)
screens.purpose: Upsell the user to premium plans with animated pricing cards.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal. Top headline ('Unlock Cinematic Pro'). Monthly/Yearly segmented control toggle. Two primary pricing cards (Face Premium vs Ultimate) arranged horizontally or stacked, with the 'Ultimate' card slightly larger, glowing, and featuring a gradient border. Sticky 'Start Free Trial' or 'Subscribe' CTA. Links for Restore, Privacy, Terms at the bottom.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: iOS-native grouped list style. Sections for Preferences (Language EN/RU, Dark Mode toggle), Account (Restore Purchases, Delete Account, Logout), and Support. Chevron indicators on rows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark and light mode color palette. The app uses '1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces' for a premium, Apple-quality finish.
Implement the 'Before/After Slider' on the Result screen using React Native Reanimated and Gesture Handler (PanGestureHandler) for a smooth 60fps native feel.

The Subscription Screen MUST feature animated pricing cards. Use Reanimated to handle the toggle between Monthly and Yearly, smoothly transitioning the prices. The 'Ultimate' tier should be visually emphasized with a subtle gradient border and scale bump.

Implement a sticky bottom primary CTA pattern for 'Apply Effect' and 'Subscribe' buttons. The background of this container must use `expo-blur` (glassmorphism) so the scrolling content is visible beneath it.
Do NOT use pure black or default blue colors. The brand color is a cinematic Red-Orange (`#FF3B30`).
All images used as backgrounds or cards MUST implement the vertical gradient-to-dark scrim pattern to ensure foreground text contrast.
Include subtle haptic feedback using `expo-haptics` on slider movement, tab switching, and button presses.
Use `react-native-reanimated` for all layout transitions, such as navigating between the categories (Face/Vehicle/House/Object) in the Effects Grid.
